verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS file-conversion service publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack mentions official SDKs but never states that the product's source, or even the SDKs' source, is available under an open license. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
